delegatecall_context.meaning: injectSweepAndCall executes in a delegatecall context where address(this) is the user's wallet/shim

funds_recoverable.meaning: funds transferred into the router have a clear path to recovery when TARGET is misconfigured, malicious, or fails
funds_recoverable.checkpoint: after injectSweepAndCall execution when TARGET fails

assumptions: injectSweepAndCall is invoked directly on the router contract in the vulnerable scenario.
TARGET is misconfigured, malicious, or fails during the call.
Tokens are transferred from msg.sender into address(this) before the external call.

unresolved.description: Report does not define a concrete recovery mechanism or observable recovery path; funds_recoverable is a qualitative Boolean standing in for the stated absence of a clear recovery path.

limitations: Formalizes only the funds-stuck impact; the separate drain impact is not covered by this plan.
delegatecall_context and funds_recoverable are qualitative Booleans because the report gives no numeric or address-level definition.
The report does not assert that a direct call was actually observed; the scenario is conditional.
